handoff: review#2: review#1 F1–F6 fixed; D1–D5 code sound. Blocking: F1 skill's watch check can't see a missing watch before stories are in auto (heartbeatDown needs an auto unit), B8/B9; F2 flake rerun --step on a unit back at implement is refused (running) and run cancel is forbidden, B42; F3 view/load.ts earlier-rounds cache races with the snapshot, never invalidates, drops receipt errors; F4 B6/B27/B31/B40 UNTRACED at S2. Minor: run view round mark + delegated reject/rerun untested, no CI-for-head command. Table in handoff.

findings.title: Watch check runs before anything makes heartbeatDown fire
findings.detail:
The skill checks `groups.unblock[]` for an id starting `heartbeat:` 'Before you start'. heartbeatDown (packages/core/src/inbox/items.ts:90-98) returns null unless a story claimed here is in auto mode with a live unit, and the stories are put in auto only afterwards by the subagents (`norn story edit <story> --auto`). With no watch running the check finds nothing and supervision proceeds; the subagents then only read `story view --json`, so a dead watch leaves them in silent 5-minute `story wait` loops. Spec B8: 'no heartbeat on the checkout → one escalation: "No watch is running…"'.
Axis: spec
Suggestion: Check the heartbeat by a field that exists regardless of mode (e.g. the heartbeat's last tick in `status --json`, if exposed; otherwise expose it), or re-check after the stories are switched to auto; have subagents notice a stale heartbeat (B9). Pin with a test of the field the skill reads.

findings.title: Suspected-flake rerun is refused by norn; the way out is forbidden
findings.detail:
The skill says: when 'the unit went back to implement but the same check passes on a rerun… → `norn run rerun <unit> --step <check> --delegated …`'. A unit sent back to implement in auto mode is `running`; run-rerun.ts:40 refuses that (`running`, do instead `norn run cancel`), and `norn run cancel` is on the skill's Forbidden list. (In manual mode the unit is not blocked either → `not_stuck`.) Spec B42 example: '→ `norn run rerun gh-201 --step test --reason "fsd: suspected flake …"`'.
Axis: spec
Suggestion: Make the prescribed path work: either a code path that lets a delegated rerun move a unit back to its check (and a test at S1), or a skill text that names a sequence norn accepts (and allow cancel for exactly this case). If neither fits the spec, ask the person.

findings.title: EARLIER_ROUNDS cache can cache the current round and never invalidates
findings.detail:
delegatedDecisions calls storyRounds(story.path) after loadSnapshot read story.units[0]. If a tick creates the next round folder between those reads, that folder's path differs from current.path and it is cached (empty or half-written) while still current; after it ends, long-lived readers (`story wait`, `status` watch loops) serve the stale entry forever and its delegated decisions never show. The process-global Map is keyed by absolute path with no eviction or check, so a dropped and restarted story re-creating rounds/01-… at the same path is stale too. The comment's motivation (status --segment) does not hold: Herdr starts a new process per refresh, so the cache only helps exactly the long-lived readers where it goes stale. Also listReceipts(path).errors is dropped (S2: a failing file is reported, not skipped).
Axis: standards
Suggestion: Drop the cache, or cache only rounds numbered below the snapshot's current round and key on something that changes (folder mtime); reuse store loadRounds instead of a second round walk; surface receipt errors.

findings.title: Behaviour items the Plan put at S2 are UNTRACED
findings.detail:
The Plan's coverage table puts B6 ('only the supervisor speaks, story named'), B27 ('really stuck escalated with receipts'), B31 (refinement on the person's behalf once #197 exists) and B40 ('the release, install, restart order') at S2 unit, but no asserted term pins any of them: B6's comment lists it but no term covers 'only one who talks to the person'/'Name the story'; B27 has no 'Stuck again' term; B40's order is not asserted. Weak too: B12 (the person's reply becomes `story answer` without --delegated), B36 (an unknown workflow escalated).
Axis: spec
Suggestion: Add a term per item to the assets tests (the text already says most of it), e.g. 'only one who talks to the person', 'Stuck again', the install→pull→restart order, 'a workflow the skill does not know'.

findings.title: Round mark in run view and delegated reject/rerun not exercised
findings.detail:
B34: '`norn run view gh-203` shows "round 03 quick — delegated (supervisor)…"' — no test reads the round mark (timeline.ts:65). No test runs a delegated `story reject` or `run rerun`.
Axis: spec
Suggestion: Assert the round row in run view/list; add a delegated reject and rerun case.

findings.title: No way named to read CI for the exact head
findings.detail:
`ready` only on green CI for the exact head, but the skill only gives `gh pr view <branch> --json state,headRefOid`, no checks field.
Axis: spec
Suggestion: Name e.g. `gh pr view <branch> --json headRefOid,statusCheckRollup` and compare the run's head sha.

findings.title: `comment` not required with `delegated` in the schema
findings.detail:
Enforced only by the cli; a mailbox receipt with delegated:true and no comment renders an empty reason (load.ts reason "").
Axis: standards
Suggestion: Optional; or render 'no reason' explicitly.

findings.title: Duplicated delegated suffix; kind typed as string
findings.detail:
`${delegatedMark(r)}${r.comment ? `: ${r.comment}` : ""}` repeats in timeline.ts (37–65) and steps.ts (472–481); DelegatedDecision.kind is `string` (types.ts:554) and orient.ts delegatedWhat switches on bare strings.
Axis: standards
Suggestion: One decisionSuffix(r) helper; type kind as the union of the five receipt kinds.
